text.description_html:
Acorn AKMBR, 6-1/4" Offset Connecticut Shutter Hinge

The perfect shutter hardware can really elevate a home's curb appeal. If you want something that looks as if it could have been made in the old west but will stand the test of time, Acorn's 6-1/4 Inch Offset Connecticut Style Strap Shutter Hinge with Pintle will do just that. It is made out of stainless steel--strap, pintle and fasteners--so you know that it will last. It has a matte black finish for a rustic look. This hinge has a 1-1/4 inch offset to swing clear of the reveal.

Features of the 6-1/4" Offset Connecticut Shutter Hinge

  • Material: Stainless steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Packaged Includes: 4 strap hinges, 4 pintles, and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Offset Connecticut Style Strap and Pintle Shutter Hinge:

  • Length: 6-1/4"
  • Pintle Length: 3/8"
  • Offset: 1-1/4"

Priced and sold as 2 pairs (4 hinges, one set for each shutter).
